(leave english as default ofcourse and other settings that not tied exactly to my computer, it must be new user friendly)

Default is every 1 hour trigger, default is ON, make "newday" as sound default, volume 1, no notification and it has no timer appearing in the timer section in main window. User can richly configure these Interval Notification on his own, 1 or sumultanioeusly enabled, each with it's settings, when trigger etc, so the main idea is interval reminder for something that user declares himself.

• Ctrl + F hides/unhides search.

• Global change: F Keys now opens the Projects instead of Snippets (in settings configurable ofcours in hotkeys). I want simply navigate within projects by f keys now.

• [clipboard_20260825_184419_35002c58.png](file:///V:/___VAC/_PIC/_Clipboard_stuff/clipboard_20260825_184419_35002c58.png) I'd like to fully reconstruct the timers interface it is currently ugly and untuitive, buttons are spread etc

• Make configurable little bar for 10 most recent/favorite/preconfigured choosed sounds that user can fastly choose preferred sound. Make first 3 as defaults: newday, newweek, newmonth

• Need to be sure the VOL is working in timer sound

• I want to select with 1 click instead of 2 the item on the Timer list

---
[x] ~~• Shift + Click по времени добавлятет срочный/focused/temp таймер на 15 минут. Это экспресс-одноразка где юзер может просто Shift + Click по времени нажать и там сразу на место текущего таймера и отсчёта зменяется текущими 15 минут, где юзер может настроить количество добавляемого времени (15 минут дефолт, там настраиваемо), звук, нотификацию и так далее всё как обычно как обычный таймер, но со своим функционалом, типо удалить сразу после срабатывания или оставить как done etc. Это должна быть влкадка Temp Timer. Причём это не ограничивается единственным кликом, а юзер может интерактивно добавлять также назначенное время как прибавление (типо 15;30;45;60 час час:15 и так далее)~~


---



• Also, the Typecheck big project (default off): For all lanugages there is dictionary for basic typecheck of the words. It does not must be dumb and unpredictable, but very well and smart.

• It cannot be recursive to avioid conflicts.

• Read the folder as Silos: I want now a function that converts the Project (Available function in the Context menu when clicking on project button/selected current in combolist) into real-time scanning project that reads the selected folder (Configurable after user agreed to convert the project to -> Sync-Project) and converts each file that conatins text (.txt;.md;.js etc etc etc all normal popular readable files with text) in each individual silo. The editing are both-sided editable and re-syncable in realtime.

• So yeah, this is the point like I want the Sync-Project where each silo is already-upped with the contents of folder. Make there also Include/Exclude options as well in Settings (New Sync-Project section with its settings accordingly)

• Also, make for standart silo in standart project new context option that says "Sync/Link this silo with..." like it says: I want make that silo to sync with a file both sides as well. And make it revertable like unlink too etc etc etc. Make sure all is working correctly please

• Also, if the date have been set via calendar and the date have been passed, thenm make the Date and Time counter reddish/user controllable color that indicates the user need attention to passed event that he have been set earlier to not forget etc.


---



• Смотри чтобы live preview нормально работало.
